Name: Pet Junimo
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


Replaces your cat or dog with a Junimo sprite. It will walk around, sleep, and dance. Comes in six colors: white, green, yellow, blue, pink, red. Only download and use one file. Disclaimer: They will still use their original cat and dog sounds. It is not as noticeable on the cat version but the dog version you will hear it.
